annotation_policy.stimulus_contains: Direct or explicitly uncertain visual observations only; no hidden intention or future outcome.
annotation_policy.species_reason: slender brown/yellow insects clustered on an exposed papery comb
annotation_policy.species_uncertainty: Exact species and taxonomic level are not established by the footage.
annotation_policy.pre_person_rule: Do not instantiate a person or another-mind model from the ambiguous gray foreground edge in tick 22.
annotation_policy.camera_rule: Current controller, physical support, and probable setup actor are independent time-indexed properties.

persistent_palette: tan and brown dead plant matter

segments.summary: A large brown papery open-cell comb hangs among branches and fills most of the lower and central frame. Many slender orange-brown and yellow-marked insects densely cover it; they are probably wasps, but exact species is unknown.
segments.layout: Comb: foreground center/lower center. Thin brown branches: upper and side edges. Green leaves: background and margins. Bright sky flecks: small gaps behind foliage.
segments.motion: Many insects crawl over the comb; some wing flicker is visible. The camera drifts slightly but remains close.
segments.camera_evidence: Close moving viewpoint; no camera holder, support, reflection, hand, or shadow is visible.
segments.audio: Outdoor ambience and speech-like audio may be present, but the speaker is not visually identified.

segments.summary: The same insect-covered papery comb remains visible while the viewpoint begins moving away and sideways.
segments.layout: Comb shifts from dominant center toward the left; green leaves and branches occupy more of the frame.
segments.motion: Camera translation and rotation increase; insect crawling continues but is harder to isolate during motion.
segments.camera_evidence: Motion is consistent with a handheld camera but does not reveal who or what controls it.
segments.audio: Outdoor ambience with possible off-screen speech; source remains unknown.

segments.summary: The comb exits left as the image sweeps rapidly through green foliage and branches.
segments.layout: Motion-blurred green leaves and brown stems fill the portrait frame; no person is identifiable.
segments.motion: Fast pan/tilt produces strong diagonal and horizontal blur.
segments.camera_evidence: Strong purposeful-looking motion raises the handheld-human hypothesis, but automated or remote movement is not excluded.
segments.audio: Outdoor ambience and possible off-screen voice; source remains unassigned.

segments.summary: The camera continues sweeping past shrubs, pale sky, and dark green canopy. No person is yet identifiable.
segments.layout: Pale sky dominates the upper area; dark green bushes and branches cross the center and lower area.
segments.motion: Rapid camera motion slows unevenly near the end of the interval.
segments.camera_evidence: The controller and support remain unknown. Motion alone cannot establish a human operator.
segments.audio: Possible speech continues without a visually established speaker.

segments.summary: The view slows on dense vegetation. A cropped gray fabric-like curved area enters the bottom edge, but there is not enough visible structure to identify a person.
segments.layout: Green canopy and pale sky fill most of the frame; the ambiguous gray patch occupies a small lower edge region.
segments.motion: Camera motion decelerates while the gray foreground patch moves relative to the frame.
segments.camera_evidence: A nearby opaque object may be associated with the camera movement, but camera controller remains unknown.
segments.audio: Speech-like sound may be nearby; speaker identity remains unknown.

segments.summary: An adult man becomes identifiable close to the camera. He has medium-brown skin, short dark hair, a narrow partial moustache, small dark chin hair, and wears a gray-olive green T-shirt.
segments.layout: His cropped face and upper torso enter from the left and then occupy the center/lower foreground; green foliage and pale sky remain behind him.
segments.motion: He and the camera move together at close range; his mouth moves as if speaking and his arms are near the lens but hand-camera contact is not always visible.
segments.camera_evidence: The newly visible man is a plausible current controller because of proximity and coupled motion, but direct continuous hand contact is not resolved.
segments.audio: A nearby adult male voice aligns with his mouth movement; language sounds likely Portuguese, exact words are uncertain.

segments.summary: The man leans directly toward the camera, looking near the lens and speaking. His olive-gray shirt, face, forearms, and the top of tan-brown shorts are visible.
segments.layout: Face: upper-center foreground. Torso: center. Forearms occasionally enter lower sides. Vegetation: full background. Reddish soil and dry tan fronds first become visible low behind him.
segments.motion: Small frame shifts coincide with his close movements; he appears to position or steady the recording device.
segments.camera_evidence: Evidence strongly favors person_1 as temporary current controller/setup actor, though the camera body and support are out of view.
segments.audio: Likely Portuguese male speech continues; expression alternates between focused and amused.

segments.summary: The man turns and bends away toward frame-left while the view settles into a stable wide portrait composition.
segments.layout: His torso and tan shorts slide down and left; dense green shrubs dominate center; reddish soil and dead tan/brown fronds cover the lower background.
segments.motion: His body moves independently while background framing becomes nearly fixed.
segments.camera_evidence: Visible control ends. The camera appears to have been released onto an unseen support; current controller transitions toward none.
segments.audio: Male speech or breathing remains near the microphone.

segments.summary: The man moves farther away and partly out of frame-left. The camera continues recording from the same fixed low-to-mid height.
segments.layout: Dense shrub canopy fills center and top; reddish ground and dry palm-like fronds fill bottom; only a cropped part of the man appears at left.
segments.motion: The background remains stable while the man moves independently.
segments.camera_evidence: No one is currently operating the camera. It is perched on an unseen stationary support. Person_1 remains the probable earlier setup actor, which is a historical relation rather than current control.
segments.audio: Ambient outdoor sound and more distant male speech.

segments.summary: At the left and lower portion of the stable frame, the man retrieves and begins opening a very large thin translucent plastic sack or sheet.
segments.layout: Man: left/midground. Milky-clear white plastic: lower-left spreading toward center. Green shrubs: center/background. Brown ground debris: bottom.
segments.motion: He shakes and pulls the plastic apart; the sheet billows and changes shape.
segments.camera_evidence: Camera remains unattended and fixed on its unseen perch.
segments.audio: Distant male speech and plastic rustling over outdoor ambience.

segments.summary: The man pulls the olive-gray green T-shirt upward over his torso and head, exposing his medium-brown chest, back, and shoulders.
segments.layout: Man: left/midground. Shirt bunches around arms/head. Translucent bag remains low. Vegetation fills background.
segments.motion: Arms lift overhead and the shirt clears his head.
segments.camera_evidence: Fixed unattended view continues.
segments.audio: Cloth and plastic rustle; intermittent speech is possible.

segments.summary: Now shirtless, the man bends toward the ground, lowers the removed shirt, and repositions the large translucent bag.
segments.layout: Bare back/torso and tan shorts: left/lower midground. Shirt and bag: near the ground at lower-left/center, partly occluded by his body.
segments.motion: He bends, reaches down, and shifts fabric and plastic.
segments.camera_evidence: Camera remains perched and unattended.
segments.audio: Rustling and outdoor ambience.

segments.summary: The shirtless man stands and spreads the mouth of the very large translucent bag with both hands.
segments.layout: Man: left/midground, back mostly toward camera. Bag: broad milky-clear shape across lower-left and center. Shrubs: background.
segments.motion: He pulls opposite edges apart and lifts the bag; plastic ripples.
segments.camera_evidence: Stable unattended composition.
segments.audio: Prominent plastic rustle with ambient insects/foliage and occasional speech.

segments.summary: Holding the bag open, the man walks deeper into the vegetation toward the earlier comb's general area.
segments.layout: His shirtless back is central midground; the translucent bag spans his hands and lower body; dense dark-green foliage partly occludes the destination.
segments.motion: He advances away from the camera and raises the bag.
segments.camera_evidence: No current operator; fixed view persists.
segments.audio: Plastic and vegetation rustle; distant speech may continue.

segments.summary: The man raises and positions the open plastic bag around or immediately beneath a branch in the comb area, though foliage and plastic obscure the exact contact point.
segments.layout: Shirtless back: center/right midground. Raised translucent bag: center/left against dark foliage. Branches cross behind and through the occluded work area.
segments.motion: He makes repeated small lifts, reaches, and edge adjustments while holding the bag open.
segments.camera_evidence: Camera remains unattended on an unseen support.
segments.audio: Plastic crinkling, foliage movement, and outdoor ambience.

segments.summary: With his back to the camera, the man continues holding and working the bag around the obscured branch/comb area.
segments.layout: Man and translucent bag occupy central midground; bag edges intermittently blend with pale sky and bright leaves; dense green canopy surrounds the work area.
segments.motion: Repeated arm reaches, short pulls, and plastic ripples occur without a large position change.
segments.camera_evidence: Stable unattended view.
segments.audio: Continuing plastic/leaf rustle and possible low male speech.

segments.summary: The man makes larger pulling and gathering motions, drawing the plastic away from the branch area and bunching part of the bag.
segments.layout: His back and arms remain central; the bag shifts downward and away from the foliage; the exact contents are partly hidden by folds.
segments.motion: Stronger pulls and shakes deform the bag and nearby leaves.
segments.camera_evidence: Stable unattended view.
segments.audio: Sharper plastic crinkles and vegetation movement.

segments.summary: The man turns away from the foliage carrying a gathered, visibly weighted bag. Brown clustered material and small dark insect-sized specks are intermittently visible through the translucent plastic.
segments.layout: Man: central midground turning toward camera. Bag: beside and in front of him, lower-center/left. Foliage: background.
segments.motion: He steps toward the camera while the loaded bag swings and its contents shift.
segments.camera_evidence: Camera remains fixed; person approaches it but does not yet visibly take control.
segments.audio: Footsteps, bag rustling, and possible speech grow closer.

segments.summary: The shirtless man approaches frontally with the large insect-containing bag, occasionally gesturing with a free hand. The bright red/pink waistband with white lettering is conspicuous above tan shorts.
segments.layout: Man grows from midground to foreground center. Bag swings at left/front and expands in frame. Dark specks and brown material show through cloudy plastic. Blue/dark sandals may be briefly visible low in frame.
segments.motion: Forward walking enlarges him and the bag; plastic and contents sway.
segments.camera_evidence: The camera is still fixed and unattended while he approaches; earlier setup history remains distinct from current control.
segments.audio: Closer male speech, footsteps, and loud plastic rustling.

segments.summary: The large translucent plastic bag is lifted or swung extremely close to the lens, covering most or nearly all of the image. Numerous dark probable-wasp shapes and brown contents are visible through folds.
segments.layout: Cloudy clear/white plastic dominates foreground; dark specks and brown patches move within/against it; green background and the man appear only through gaps or translucent layers.
segments.motion: Bag folds sweep across the lens, causing rapid occlusion, blur, and changing translucency.
segments.camera_evidence: The bag contacts or passes very near the camera's field of view; whether the camera itself is touched is uncertain.
segments.audio: Very loud plastic crinkling with nearby male voice and insect/ambient noise.

segments.summary: The bag lowers enough to reveal the shirtless man close to the camera. He grips and manipulates gathered plastic near the bag's top or mouth.
segments.layout: Man: right/center foreground. Bunched translucent plastic and dark specks: lower and left foreground. Green foliage: background.
segments.motion: Hands pull, twist, and reposition folds; bag contents shift.
segments.camera_evidence: Camera framing remains essentially fixed despite very close activity.
segments.audio: Close speech and plastic crackle.

segments.summary: The man separates and reopens portions of the gathered bag mouth instead of simply keeping it closed.
segments.layout: His bare torso fills right/center foreground; both hands work a broad translucent opening across lower/center frame; dark insect-sized specks remain visible.
segments.motion: Opposing hand pulls widen the plastic opening and flatten folds.
segments.camera_evidence: Camera remains fixed on its perch.
segments.audio: Plastic dominates; male speech may accompany the demonstration.

segments.summary: He spreads the bag opening broadly in front of his waist and torso while standing close to the lens. The probable wasps and brown contents remain associated with the plastic.
segments.layout: Bare torso: upper-right/center. Arms and hands: sides of the broad bag mouth. Translucent plastic: center/lower foreground. Vegetation: narrow background margins.
segments.motion: The opening expands horizontally; the man shifts his stance and looks down toward it.
segments.camera_evidence: Fixed unattended recording continues.
segments.audio: Close speech, breathing, and plastic rustle.

segments.summary: Still holding the bag open, the man lowers his head and upper torso toward the opening. At this point contact is imminent, but the final action is not yet complete.
segments.layout: Head and shoulders descend from upper-right/center toward the central bag mouth; plastic rises around the lower foreground.
segments.motion: His neck, shoulders, and torso bend downward while his hands maintain the opening.
segments.camera_evidence: Camera remains fixed; no current operator.
segments.audio: Plastic crackle and close vocal/breath sounds.

segments.summary: The man deliberately lowers his head and upper body through the opening of the insect-containing bag. Plastic folds rise over his head, neck, and shoulders.
segments.layout: Bent torso and bag dominate the close foreground; his head becomes obscured inside translucent plastic; vegetation remains behind.
segments.motion: A continuous controlled downward movement places more of his upper body inside; this does not resemble an accidental brief snag.
segments.camera_evidence: Camera remains fixed and unattended during the action.
segments.audio: Loud plastic movement and close vocal/breath sounds.

segments.summary: The man's head and much of his upper torso remain inside or underneath the large bag with the captured probable wasps and comb-like material. He stays bent forward.
segments.layout: Tan shorts/red waistband and bent lower torso: right/lower foreground. Translucent plastic covers the upper-body area across center/right. Green shrubs fill uncovered background.
segments.motion: Plastic ripples and the covered upper body shifts; he does not immediately withdraw.
segments.camera_evidence: Stable unattended view.
segments.audio: Sustained plastic rustle, muffled vocal/breath sounds, and outdoor ambience.

segments.summary: He continues holding his upper body within the insect-containing bag for several more seconds, bent close to the camera.
segments.layout: Bag-covered upper body remains center/right foreground; shorts and bright waistband remain visible lower-right; green and brown outdoor background stays fixed.
segments.motion: Repeated small body shifts and plastic undulations occur without exit.
segments.camera_evidence: Stable unattended view.
segments.audio: Plastic rustling and muffled sounds continue.

segments.summary: The man remains intentionally inside/under the bag, then begins shifting upward near the end of the interval.
segments.layout: Covered upper body and plastic dominate lower-right/center; foliage and pale sky remain unobstructed at left/top.
segments.motion: Plastic folds slide and lift as his posture gradually rises.
segments.camera_evidence: Camera remains perched and unattended.
segments.audio: Plastic movement grows sharper as he prepares to emerge.

segments.summary: The man pulls his head and upper body out from the plastic, and the bag drops lower around him.
segments.layout: Head and bare shoulders reappear center/right; translucent plastic falls toward lower frame; vegetation remains background.
segments.motion: Rapid upward withdrawal and downward bag collapse.
segments.camera_evidence: Camera remains fixed.
segments.audio: Fast plastic collapse and close vocal/breath sound.

segments.summary: Standing shirtless, the man rapidly brushes, rubs, or slaps his shoulders, arms, chest, and head while looking over his body.
segments.layout: Man: center/right foreground. Hands move across bare skin. Bag hangs or lies low in frame. Vegetation remains behind.
segments.motion: Quick repeated hand-to-body contacts and scanning head movements.
segments.camera_evidence: Camera remains fixed and unattended.
segments.audio: Breathing, possible exclamations/laughter, and residual plastic rustle.

segments.summary: He continues rubbing his head, shoulders, back, and torso, then visibly smiles or laughs and begins moving toward the camera.
segments.layout: Man grows larger at center; bare skin and tan shorts dominate foreground; bag remains lower/behind; green foliage fills margins.
segments.motion: Body-checking motions slow while forward movement increases.
segments.camera_evidence: Still no current operator while he approaches the perched camera.
segments.audio: Audible laughter becomes the clearest semantic audio event.

segments.summary: The shirtless man approaches until his smiling/laughing face and upper torso fill much of the frame, looking toward the lens as the clip ends.
segments.layout: Face: center/upper foreground, increasingly large. Bare shoulders/torso: lower foreground. Green foliage and pale sky: shrinking background margins.
segments.motion: Forward approach and head movement produce growing facial scale; the perched camera itself remains largely stationary.
segments.camera_evidence: The man is near the camera again, but proximity alone does not establish renewed control before the clip ends.
segments.audio: Close laughter and amused vocalization dominate.
